theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  case' red_I.par c a' ha hb | red_K.par d c' ha hb | red_S.par d c' ha hb =>
    apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨x, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

  ParallelReduction.rec (motive := fun {a a₁} h₁ => ∀ {a₂ : SKI}, a ⭢ₚ a₂ → Join ParallelReduction a₁ a₂)
    (fun a {a₂} h₂ => Exists.intro a₂ ⟨h₂, ParallelReduction.refl a₂⟩)
    (fun a {a₂} h₂ =>
      ParallelReduction.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 a_2 t =>
        I ⬝ a = a_1 → a₂ = a_2 → h₂ ≍ t → Join ParallelReduction a a₂) h₂

          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a_2 => a₂ = a_2 → h₂ ≍ ParallelReduction.refl a_2 → Join ParallelReduction a a₂)
